title: Miracle Quiz

blocks.text: The Midnight Trivia Miracle Quiz is optional content located under TV Listings. There are three stages, and each stage must be completed to unlock the next. Winning the third and final stage will earn you a trophy in your room. Each stage consists of twenty multiple choice questions. A correct answer gives one point while an incorrect answer will lose one point. Whoever has the highest score at the end is the winner. If there is a tie, then there is no winner. Here are all of the known questions in the quiz. Note that due to the nature of this quiz, there may be a few questions missing from this list. If you find one not on the list, send me a screenshot and I'll add it to the list.
Question List

Q: All the lockers at the entrance in the Steamy Bathhouse have the same number. What is that number?
A: 201

Q: Among the boys of Yasogami High, what is the ritual of asking Yukiko out on a date called?
A: The Amagi Challenge

Q: At Okina Station, on which side of the stairways are the escalators?
A: Both sides

Q: At the entrance to the TV world that you get in from the TV at Junes, who is standing just to Teddie's right?
A: Chie

Q: Chagall Cafe in front of Okina Station is known for its owner's original blend. What is the owner's name?
A: Mumon

Q: "Daidara Metalworks" in the central shopping district is known for its scar-faced owner. What does the dot after "Daidara" mean?
A: Daidara Bocchi

A: Runaway express train
